prompt:
Game VFX art for a 2D anime fantasy mobile RPG, same style as the second reference (an approved see-through fox-goddess spirit of fire lines) but for the hero in the first reference: Noct (shadow hero, a hooded reaper in dark cloak).
Draw ONE giant guardian spirit: an original a MOON-SHADOW WRAITH: a towering hooded spectral figure of moonlight and shadow, a pale glowing face under the hood, a tattered flowing cloak like smoke, a pale crescent moon halo behind the hood, seen from the waist up, rising out of a low soft base of glowing mist.
It must read as a SEE-THROUGH spirit, like a glowing light projection: drawn mainly with bright luminous outlines and highlights (moon-silver, pale lilac and deep violet-grey, with cold white cores; wisps of shadow smoke), strongest on the face, shoulders, arms and hands, while the inside of the body and mantle is only a very faint thin glow, mostly empty so the background would show through. Not a solid figure.
Pose that must be obvious at small size: her two long arms come forward and down on BOTH sides, open hands curving inward toward each other around an EMPTY space at the bottom centre — sheltering a small figure standing there (do not draw the figure). NO weapon, nothing held in the hands. Keep a clear dark gap between each arm and the mantle.
Composition: tall portrait image, centred; the top of the head (ears or antlers or hood tip) is the HIGHEST point, about 4% below the top edge; the face at about 20–25% from the top; nothing rises above the head; the spirit fills about 94% of the height; the empty sheltered space between the hands is about 40% of the image width.
Background: PURE FLAT BLACK #000000 everywhere outside the glowing lines (keyed by brightness). No ground, no scenery, no text, no frame, no watermark, no vignette.

precheck.summary: The candidate matches the prompt: one hooded spectral figure with a glowing face, a crescent moon halo behind the hood, both arms reaching down and inward around an empty centre, no weapon, and a flat black background. The crescent halo rises slightly above the hood tip, a minor layout deviation rather than a clear defect, and the figure reads as luminous outlines rather than a solid body.
